invalid_arguments.description: The caller supplied missing, unknown, or type-invalid arguments.

tool_error.description: The tool could not complete a bounded local operation.

timeout.description: A bounded network or local operation exceeded its deadline.

tools.name: qiongli_config_status
tools.description: Return redacted Qiongli provider configuration status.

notes: Only provider state and an allowlisted search configuration summary may be returned; provider values remain redacted.

QIONGLI_CONFIG_HOME must be a fully qualified absolute path or use the portable ~ or ~/... home notation; rooted or drive-prefixed home suffixes and other relative values fail closed, and an unset value resolves from the platform user home without falling back to the process working directory.
config_path is an intentional local identifier that can reveal the user's home-directory layout and must not be copied into shared artifacts or logs.

tools.name: qiongli_save_provider_config
tools.description: Save explicit Qiongli provider config values from chat or scripts. Prefer qiongli_configure_provider for API keys.

notes: The value argument can contain a provider credential and must never appear in content, structuredContent, errors, logs, or diagnostics.

Configuration updates fail closed when the existing global file is malformed. Writes use POSIX mode 0600 on Unix. Rust Lite applies a protected current-user-only DACL before atomic replacement on Windows; the legacy Node MCPB remains read-only there because it cannot enforce that DACL.

QIONGLI_CONFIG_HOME must be a fully qualified absolute path or use the portable ~ or ~/... home notation; rooted or drive-prefixed home suffixes and other relative values fail closed, and an unset value resolves from the platform user home without falling back to the process working directory.
config_path is an intentional local identifier that can reveal the user's home-directory layout and must not be copied into shared artifacts or logs.

tools.name: qiongli_configure_provider
tools.description: Start a tokenized loopback setup page and return its URL for provider configuration. Prefer this for API keys so secrets do not enter chat history.

side_effects.trigger: An authorized user submits a supported non-empty provider field.

notes: Provider credentials are accepted only by the tokenized loopback page, never by MCP arguments.
The returned URL contains an ephemeral bearer token and must be treated as sensitive control data.

QIONGLI_CONFIG_HOME must be a fully qualified absolute path or use the portable ~ or ~/... home notation; rooted or drive-prefixed home suffixes and other relative values fail closed, and an unset value resolves from the platform user home without falling back to the process working directory.
config_path is an intentional local identifier that can reveal the user's home-directory layout.
The listener binds only to loopback and does not launch a browser or external process.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_status
tools.description: Report configured literature providers and capability mode without exposing secrets.

notes: Only provider readiness, active-provider identity, implemented capabilities, activation-field names, and redacted configuration state may be returned.
Provider capability records share one schema, but each runtime profile must report only behavior it actually implements; Lite capability lists may be strict subsets of Full.
Provider credentials, environment values, malformed configuration content, and local configuration paths must not appear in results or errors.
Configured status is local readiness metadata, not a live provider health guarantee.

tools.name: qiongli_search_plan
tools.description: Plan provider and platform-native literature search routing without executing search.

notes: The tool plans routes only and must not execute provider, platform-native, process, or agent operations.
Research queries and generated routes may be returned to the caller but must not be copied into shared logs automatically.
During the v2 compatibility window, year filters emit canonical from_year/to_year together with deprecated fromYear/toYear aliases.
Provider credentials, environment values, malformed configuration content, and local configuration paths must not appear in plans or errors.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_export_evidence
tools.description: Export an auditable provider capability, search plan, diagnostics, and result snapshot.

notes: Evidence export is side-effect free and must not add provider credentials to the snapshot.
